free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fix random before constructing sequences (tier is overwritten explicitly)

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: cache block size used by the block manager in the repository

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_blocks
free_parameters.why: free block count; after one decode block the memory budget is 999, selecting the low-memory search space whose first entry is 128 as the claim describes

free_parameters.name: max_model_len
free_parameters.why: prompt limit large enough for the 1024-token prefill witness

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: deadline scheduler chunk size; only gates the decode loop before the target

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold
free_parameters.why: removes the decode-deadline term; the slack is supplied exactly by the prescribed deadline

free_parameters.name: decode_prompt_tokens
free_parameters.why: context of the running decode sequence

free_parameters.name: decode_processed_tokens
free_parameters.why: marks the decode sequence as having finished its prompt, so it is a decode in _schedule

free_parameters.name: prefill_prompt_tokens
free_parameters.why: prefill witness longer than the returned chunk so work remains below the target

free_parameters.name: prefill_context_tokens
free_parameters.why: non-zero prefill context estimate passed to _get_prefill_size_by_slack

free_parameters.name: tier_deadline
free_parameters.why: large ttft deadline so eager relegation below the target is deterministically not taken

hooks.name: prescribed_slack_deadline
hooks.purpose: the running decode sequence is an input object whose _get_TBT_deadline reports the caller-supplied slack exactly (0 or 1); this makes the min_slack local at the target deterministic instead of depending on wall-clock time
